shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; git ls-files
cat index.html src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && for i in House Persons ShoppingCart Gear ChevronsLeft ChevronsRight ChevronDown ChevronRight Grip Bars ArrowLeft ArrowRight Xmark Layers; do ls icons/esm/$i.js >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ok $i || echo MISSING $i; done; ls uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; grep -o '\-\-g-color-base-selection[a-z-]*\|--g-color-base-simple-hover[a-z-]*\|--g-color-line-generic[a-z-]*\|--g-color-base-float[a-z-]*\|--g-color-base-background\b' uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u
rm -rf dist; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>&1 | head; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>&1 | head; npm ls playwright puppeteer 2>&1 | head -5

for t in $(grep -oh 'var(--g-[a-z-]*' src/App.css | sed 's/var(//' | sort -u); do grep -q -- "$t:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css && echo "ok $t" || echo "MISSING $t"; done; git status --short
